name: Run reviewed executable acceptance (unit + real Docker restart)
run:
docker info > /dev/null
# HazardSandbox does not auto-pull; a missing base image would fail
# the replay for an infrastructure reason, so pull it explicitly.
docker pull python:3.11-slim
docker image inspect python:3.11-slim > /dev/null
python -m pytest \
  tests/test_reviewed_executable_skill.py \
  tests/test_reviewed_executable_service_restart.py \
  -q --tb=short --timeout=900 --timeout-method=thread
# Truthful cleanup gate: the sandbox creates one skill_* container
# per execution and must remove it.  A passing receipt is not enough
# if a stopped container leaked, so assert the daemon has none left.
leftover=$(docker ps -a --filter "name=skill_" --format '{{.Names}}')
if [ -n "$leftover" ]; then
  echo "sandbox containers leaked after the acceptance run:" >&2
  echo "$leftover" >&2
  exit 1
fi
# Fail closed if the real-Docker record was not emitted or does not
# actually prove a container ran, was removed, and the receipt
# survived the service restart (no host fallback is acceptable).
python - <<'PY'
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

record_path = Path(os.environ["ATOM_ACCEPTANCE_OUTPUT"])
if not record_path.is_file():
    raise SystemExit(
        f"real-Docker acceptance receipt missing: {record_path}")
record = json.loads(record_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
if record.get("docker_sandbox_real") is not True:
    raise SystemExit(
        f"acceptance receipt does not prove real Docker: {record}")
if record.get("sandbox_backend") != "docker":
    raise SystemExit(
        f"acceptance receipt backend is not docker: {record}")
if not str(record.get("container_id") or "").startswith("skill_"):
    raise SystemExit(
        f"acceptance receipt has no skill container id: {record}")
if not record.get("docker_container_id"):
    raise SystemExit(
        "acceptance receipt has no Docker container id: "
        f"{record}")
if record.get("sandbox_container_removed") is not True:
    raise SystemExit(
        "acceptance receipt does not prove the sandbox container was "
        f"removed: {record}")
if record.get("sandbox_cleanup_error"):
    raise SystemExit(
        "acceptance receipt recorded a cleanup failure: "
        f"{record}")
if record.get("sandbox_timed_out") is not False:
    raise SystemExit(
        "acceptance receipt recorded a timed-out sandbox run: "
        f"{record}")
if record.get("nonce_echo_verified") is not True:
    raise SystemExit(
        "acceptance receipt did not verify the container nonce: "
        f"{record}")
if record.get("durable_receipt_verified") is not True:
    raise SystemExit(
        "acceptance receipt did not re-read the durable receipt "
        f"after restart: {record}")
print(f"real-Docker acceptance receipt verified: {record_path}")
PY

name: Run joined approved-skill agent dispatch Docker controls
run:
docker info > /dev/null
docker pull python:3.11-slim
docker image inspect python:3.11-slim > /dev/null
python -m pytest tests/test_reviewed_executable_skill_agent_dispatch_docker.py -q --tb=short --timeout=900 --timeout-method=thread
leftover=$(docker ps -a --filter "name=skill_" --format '{{.Names}}')
if [ -n "$leftover" ]; then
  echo "sandbox containers leaked after the joined dispatch run:" >&2
  echo "$leftover" >&2
  exit 1
fi
